Remove unnecessary request code checks while handling file picker results
While working on #5849, I saw, there are some problems with handling request codes in `FilePicker.java` 

I chose not to include these changes in the refactor (refer #5849) because these are distinct changes which should be addressed separately and it'd easier to understand from git history.

Problems were ->

- Capture Video flag was still being checked even though we never use it in any intent to launch anything.

- Even when using `Document PIcker` (default) , the `Intent` created for launching it, is passed with `Gallery Picker/Photo Picker` `requestCode` which means for both of the  methods result will be handled by only Gallery picker's callback. Though I'm not sure if this lead to any bug but still we should be using respective callbacks.

[Tech Debt] Remove usage of deprecated `startActivityForResult` & `onActivityResult` APIs  in favour of decoupled result APIs
Remove usage of deprecated `startActivityForResult` & `onActivityResult` APIs  in favour of decoupled result APIs. 

> While the underlying [startActivityForResult()](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/app/Activity#startActivityForResult(android.content.Intent,%20int)) and [onActivityResult()](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/app/Activity#onActivityResult(int,%20int,%20android.content.Intent)) APIs are available on the Activity class on all API levels, Google strongly recommends using the Activity Result APIs introduced in AndroidX [Activity](https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/activity) and [Fragment](https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/fragment) classes.

For more on what benefits it offers refer here https://developer.android.com/training/basics/intents/result#custom

P.S: We already have newer code using this API. Only some place that needs refactor.

Missing support for GoToSocial and microblog.pub links in looksLikeMastodonUrl
Tusky currently supports automated lookup of posts (i.e., URLs inside other posts) from Mastodon, Pleroma, Friendica, Misskey, and Pixelfed, but it fails when it comes to [GoToSocial](https://gotosocial.org/) or [microblog.pub](https://docs.microblog.pub/). I have absolutely no experience with Kotlin or the workflow here, so I'm not really comfortable with creating a pull request myself. But if someone is willing to do it, I believe the correct regexes are as follows:

* `"^/@[^/]+/statuses/[0-9ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZabcdefghjkmnpqrstvwxyz]{26}$"` for GoToSocial posts
  * It uses ULID, so it's guaranteed to be 26 symbols in Crockford's Base 32. And it seems to be case-insensitive.
  * See https://github.com/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial/blob/25edd57eaf3eecf0b449a4dabb5b5fc5d6ae7687/internal/id/ulid.go#L35 and https://github.com/oklog/ulid
* `"^/o/[0-9a-f]{32}$"` for microblog.pub posts
  * It uses UUID, so it's guaranteed to be 32 hex symbols. It is case-sensitive (lowercase).
  * See https://git.sr.ht/~tsileo/microblog.pub/tree/v2/item/app/boxes.py#L51
* Optionally `"^/articles/[0-9a-f]{7}/[-\\w]+$"` for microblog.pub articles
  * Articles use a combination of the short id (currently first 7 characters of the actual id) and a slug.
  * Maybe something more general like `"^/articles/[0-9a-f]+/[-\\w]+$"` should be used in case they decide to change the length of the short id.
  * This is not necessary as it would complicate getting to the actual article. Users would be forced to use the "Open in browser" button to see the whole content. (Mastodon shows only the name of the article.)
  * See https://git.sr.ht/~tsileo/microblog.pub/tree/v2/item/app/boxes.py#L658 and https://git.sr.ht/~tsileo/microblog.pub/tree/v2/item/app/utils/text.py#L5

It's supposed to go in Tusky/app/src/main/java/com/keylesspalace/tusky/BottomSheetActivity.kt.

* * * *

Old posts from other account shown on timeline, before posts from correct account.
### Detailed description

I have several accounts (let's call them A, B, C ... F) in Tusky on Android. Several of these are on Mastodon servers, and others are on GoToSocial servers. One of those GoToSocial servers, constellation.home.nora.codes, has extremely limited federation; the posts on that instance should exist on 2 other servers, exclusively (mutual federation, but none of us federate anywhere else). Let's call that account F.

However, sometimes when I add accounts to Tusky, some other accounts - say, B and D - show 30 - 32 old (May of this year) posts from that instance in their home timeline. Refreshing and clearing cache do nothing; logging out of F does nothing; logging out of B and D and back in *sometimes* fixes the issue. Reinstalling the app sometimes fixes the issue. Scrolling down shows posts from B or D's timeline below the 30 errant posts.

There is no way the instances for accounts B and D have any knowledge of posts from constellation.home.nora.codes, so I think this is purely a client issue.

Tusky URL detection breaks if capital letters in scheme://
### Steps to reproduce the problem

1. Open Compose in Mastodon Web on PC, and Tusky side by side.
2. In both, type: `Https://example.com` or `HTTPS://EXAMPLE.COM`

**Expected behavior:** Mastodon Web and Tusky should have identical behavior.

**Observed behavior:** Mastodon Web recognizes this as a url the moment you type the letter "O". Tusky cannot recognize anything as a URL, whether typed or pasted, if "https" contains an uppercase letter. After typing the url Tusky predicts 481 letters and Mastodon Web predicts 477 characters.

RFC 1738 §2.1 states clients such as Tusky should accept URL scheme as case insensitive.

#### Notes

This causes problems on my phone because GBoard wants to capitalize the leading H in a URL.

### Debug information

mastodon.social, Android 13, Tusky 26.1 from Play Store
